tools.name: zinc_get_3d
tools.description: Locate docking-ready 3D structures for ZINC compounds. ZINC22 ships pre-generated 3D conformers (DOCK ``.db2.gz``, ``.mol2.gz``, ``.sdf.gz``) in its file repository, organized by tranche — this tool resolves each id to its tranche and returns the repository locations to download from for docking prep (DOCK6, AutoDock Vina, etc.).

zinc_ids.description: ZINC ids to prepare (max 50 per call — 3D retrieval is per-compound work; keep batches small).

timeout_s.description: overall lookup budget in seconds (default 25, clamped to 5-55 — under the 60s MCP transport ceiling).

tools.returns: Returns ``{query, returned_count, structures, repository_note}``; each structure entry carries ``zinc_id``, ``found``, ``smiles``, ``source``, ``tranche_name`` + ``tranche_properties``, and ``download``: the tranche's repository directory pattern under ``https://files.docking.org/zinc22/`` plus the available 3D formats. Sub-release directories (``zinc-22a``, ``zinc-22b``, …) must be browsed for exact file names — the repository does not expose a per-compound fetch URL.

tools.name: zinc_random_sample
tools.description: Draw a random sample of purchasable compounds from ZINC22 — for building screening decks, property baselines, or decoy sets.

count.description: sample size; doubles as this tool's ``max_results`` (default 50, hard cap 500 — larger decks should be drawn in several calls, not one unbounded pull).

subset.description: optional predefined property filter — ``fragment`` (MW < 250), ``lead-like`` (MW 250-350, logP <= 3.5), ``drug-like`` (MW 350-500, Lipinski), ``lugs`` (curated); other upstream subset names pass through verbatim.

timeout_s.description: overall search budget in seconds (default 25, clamped to 5-55 — under the 60s MCP transport ceiling).

tools.returns: Returns the standard bounded shape with records as in ``zinc_search_by_id`` (random order; re-calling draws a fresh sample).

tools.name: zinc_search_by_id
tools.description: Look up purchasable compounds in ZINC22/ZINC20 by ZINC identifier — answers "what is this compound and who sells it".

zinc_ids.description: one or more ZINC ids (e.g. ``ZINC000000000012``), max 100 per call (one batched query — preferred over many single-id calls).

timeout_s.description: overall search budget in seconds (default 25, clamped to 5-55 — under the 60s MCP transport ceiling). The async backend computes server-side; a timeout error names the task uuid so the search can be re-polled.

tools.returns: Returns ``{query, total_available, returned_count, truncated, source_counts, records}``; each record carries ``zinc_id``, ``smiles``, ``catalogs`` (supplier list — the purchasability signal), ``tranche_name`` plus decoded ``tranche_properties`` (heavy atoms, logP bin), and ``source`` (``zinc22``/``zinc20``). Ids with no match simply have no record.

tools.name: zinc_search_by_smiles
tools.description: Search ZINC22's purchasable chemical space by structure — answers "what purchasable compounds look like this SMILES". This is BOTH the exact-match and the analog-discovery (similarity) tool: CartBlanche22 exposes one structure-search endpoint whose ``dist`` parameter spans exact through diverse, so there is deliberately no separate similarity-search tool.

smiles.description: query SMILES string (sent verbatim as a form field — no URL encoding needed).

dist.description: Tanimoto DISTANCE threshold 0-10 (a distance, not a percent similarity: 0 = exact structure match, 1-3 = close analogs, 4-6 = moderate analogs, 7-10 = diverse chemical space; larger = looser = slower and many more hits).

adist.description: anonymous-graph distance 0-10 (scaffold-shaped tolerance); defaults to ``dist`` like the reference workflows.

max_results.description: response bound (default 50, hard cap 500). Broad searches can match enormous sets — raise ``dist`` gradually rather than starting loose.

timeout_s.description: overall search budget in seconds (default 25, clamped to 5-55 — under the 60s MCP transport ceiling); similarity searches are the slowest ZINC queries.

tools.returns: Returns the standard bounded shape (``total_available`` vs ``returned_count``, per-source counts) with records as in ``zinc_search_by_id``.

tools.name: zinc_search_by_supplier
tools.description: Resolve vendor catalog numbers to ZINC compounds — answers "which ZINC substance is this supplier code, and what's its structure".

supplier_codes.description: one or more vendor catalog codes (e.g. ``MCULE-2311834287``), max 100 per call.

timeout_s.description: overall search budget in seconds (default 25, clamped to 5-55 — under the 60s MCP transport ceiling).

tools.returns: Returns the standard bounded shape; records additionally carry ``supplier_code`` alongside ``zinc_id``/``smiles``/``catalogs``.
